scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Oh?
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
哦？
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
We're in trouble~~
We can't have anyone know we're here~~
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
糟糕了~~
我們不能讓任何人知道我們在這裡~~

scripts.text:
[Dien]
The adventurer is here too!
Why are you scared!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
冒險者也在這裡！
你怕什麼！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Hello {0}.
We've came here to do something... It was too troublesome to tell the youngsters.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你好，{0}。
我們來這裡是為了做點事... 告訴那些小傢伙太麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If you keep it a secret that you saw us...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果你能保守秘密，不說你看到了我們...

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Sister~~
What are you talking about, I don't see the adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
姐姐~~
你在說什麼，我沒看到冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Oh~
Yeah?
I don't see the adventurer either~
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
哦~
是嗎？
我也沒看到冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
So what now?
We're already inside.
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
那現在怎麼辦？
我們已經進來了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It can't be helped~~
We have to go with the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
沒辦法了~~
我們得和冒險者一起走。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's dangerous, so please come with us.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
這裡很危險，請跟我們走。

scripts.text: - There is a pipe going through the floor. -
scripts.translation: - 地板下有一根管道穿過。 -

scripts.text: Crush it.
scripts.translation: 砸碎它

scripts.text: Put it down.
scripts.translation: 放下

scripts.text: - Nothing happened. -
scripts.translation: - 什麼也沒發生。 -

scripts.text: - The machine stopped with a strange noise when the pipe was broken. -
scripts.translation: - 管道斷裂時，機器發出奇怪的噪音停止了。 -

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh my! What's that thing in the front?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪！前面那個是什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh my! I think it's precise device that's placed here in the abandoned mine.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪！我想這是放置在這座廢棄礦坑裡的精密裝置。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If you don't break the machine on the other side, we will not be able pass it!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果你不破壞另一邊的機器，我們就無法通過！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's dangerous to go through right now, so let's turn around and go where the device is!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
現在過去很危險，我們折返去裝置那裡吧！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
If you go to the right, I think you can go back on the railroad without having to break the door.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
如果你往右走，我想可以不破壞門就回到鐵軌上。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Oh, is this gate too hard?
It will take some time to break it~
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
哎呀，這扇門很難破嗎？
要弄壞它得花點時間呢~

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
If you go to the right, I think you can go back on the railroad without having to break the door.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
如果你往右走，我想可以不破壞門就回到鐵軌上。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
可惡！

scripts.text:
[Est]
Oh...
I'm in a hurry, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦...
我趕時間，你們在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Please go back and enjoy your tea gracefully.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
請回去優雅地享用你們的茶吧。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Huh!
How did you sneak in here anyway?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
哼！
你們是怎麼偷偷溜進來的？

scripts.text:
[Est]
This is only a surveillance routine.
If you close your eyes for a second, you may run into an accident.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
這只是例行監視。
如果你們稍微疏忽大意，可能會出事故的。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
What makes you think we need your help?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
誰需要你們的幫助了？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Didn't you just did now?
I don't think I heard that wrong. Did I?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
剛才不是你們自己說的嗎？
我耳朵沒聾，聽錯了？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
You two really~
Please stop fighting.
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
你們兩個真是~
請別吵架了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
How do you always fight like that?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你們怎麼總是這樣吵架？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
I'm so excited about this~ I'm getting old and I'm tired of fighting.
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
我對此很興奮~ 我年紀大了，厭倦了戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Is that so?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Yeah~
I'm tired of fighting, let's go back to work.
The road is open now.
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
是啊~
我厭倦了戰鬥，我們回去工作吧。
路已經通了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Finally..
If you cross this door...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
終於...
穿過這扇門...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's head back now before they gather more troops.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
趁他們還沒集結更多兵力，我們趕緊回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[Est]
?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh my, oh my!
What should we do!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
天哪，天哪！
我們該怎麼辦！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Why, what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
為什麼，發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I think I've left it.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我想我把它落下了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Left what?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
落下什麼了？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
My protection charm!
I get nervous if I don't have it with me.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我的護身符！
如果沒帶在身上，我會很不安的。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
You've been fine so far without it?!
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
你之前沒帶它不也挺好的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
...

[Ridsh]
Ah... Sorry..
Alright.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
啊...抱歉..
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
While we open the last door, would you mind going back to ^FF0000Clana Nemieri^000000?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
趁我們開啟最後一扇門的時候，你介意去一趟^FF0000夜巡者轉職考試地點^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I have to contact a few people anyway, and Dien won't go anywhere until she gets her protection charm.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
反正我也得聯絡幾個人，而且迪恩在拿到護身符之前是不會走的。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Sister, tell me where it is.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
姐姐，告訴我它在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Oh!
Thank you so much for that
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
哦！
太感謝你了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's hard for me to get it back because it's far...
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
因為地方很遠，我自己去拿很困難...
請幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
^FF0000Go back to my room and look for a chest on the left side of the window, near a vase.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
^FF0000回到我的房間，在窗戶左側、花瓶附近找一個箱子。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It should be easy to get since we're here.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
既然我們在這裡，應該很容易拿到。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Oh!
Shouldn't we tell them where we are?
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
哦！
我們是不是該告訴他們在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
It's good sometimes to take a quick walk like this~
scripts.translation:
[科特內斯]
偶爾像這樣散散步也不錯~

scripts.text:
[Est]
I eager to explore the area beyond here.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我很想探索這裡以外的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I'm tired!
I want to go home.
scripts.translation:
[裡德什]
我累了！
我想回家。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It would be better to just go around the door.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
最好還是繞著門走。
